svg.title: Advanced Far Trader - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Traders and Gunboats (2024), printed 84-85, PDF 85-86. Combined projection uses broad lower working deck with long rounded forebody, wide chamfered aft fuel shoulders and narrowed twin-drive stern. Smaller upper accommodation deck is aligned aft per illustration and contained. Relative alignment interpreted; no room/fuel borders or interior cargo doors used as hull outline.
